notes:
Snapshot: Lumina runs search over 50M+ internal documents (financial reports, client contracts, internal KB). High sensitivity data (PII in contracts) so data residency + KMS are must-haves. Current stack: Pinecone for vector store (cpu-based) + a custom cross-encoder reranker served on m5 instances. Pain: slow reranker inference at scale, inconsistent relevance after nightly index updates, high cost per live query when reranker invoked.

Requirements summary:
- Indexing scale: target 25–50M live vectors, incremental updates every 4–6 hours.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end <120ms for standard queries (no heavy rerank) and fallback <300ms for full rerank path.
- Throughput: steady-state 200 qps; peak bursts 1k qps during reporting windows.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.001/query end-to-end averaged (embeddings + optional rerank amortized).
- Quality bar: no >3% MRR drop vs current production (measured on replay set).
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 1 year, EU data residency, KMS integration.

Migration plan discussed (high level):
- Phase 0: dataset export + replay harness (Redwood eval harness) — define NDCG/MRR baselines on closed eval set (100k queries).
- Phase 1: Embedding model comparison (3 candidates) on 5M doc sample, measure recall@k, latency, index size, cost.
- Phase 2: Reranker migration pilot — run new reranker variants offline, then soft-canary (5% traffic) A/B for 2 weeks with automatic rollback triggers on quality regressions.
- Phase 3: Full rollout to Dedicated cluster with autoscaling and prefix caching; add read-only on-prem replica for sensitive workloads.
